final: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(t.amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) AS share_of_total_volume FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY share_of_total_volume DESC LIMIT 10
